title: Can your Faith withstand the test?
text: if you believe then you act like you believe the fight is for your belief tell your neighbor it ain't working he can't touch my belief my faith is in God my faith is in the Rock come on give God a big praise this morning hallelujah hallelujah I ask the Holy Spirit on my bed last night in Florida I said Lord how do I close the meeting tomorrow he says I want you to create a hedge around everyone going through a test and then he showed me a scripture when Peter said Lord I will never leave you I will die for you and Jesus said Peter Satan has just demanded to test you and to sift those words to see if you're going to pass the test and then Jesus said I can't stop the test but I've prayed for your faith
